entries.descriptionSearch:
A Ragdoll sandbox where every hit matters. Dummies have bones and organs, reacting to exactly where and how you strike.

🎯 Watch dummies stumble, faint and crawl
🗺️ Explore different maps, each offering unique environments and experiments.
🦴 Heavy impacts and falls can cause broken bones.
⚡ Use tasers, restart hearts, or bring dummies back as zombies.
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Dummies interact with each other!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, Tablet, and VR Players!

entries.descriptionSearch:
The Krusty Krab is in trouble, and it needs YOU to keep its doors open! Do you have what it takes to Save the Krusty Krab? 🍔

🧽 You’re hired! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, and more iconic characters from Bikini Bottom!

⏰ Clock in and get to work! Run the register, fire up the grill, assemble orders, and deliver food!
💰 Serve up iconic dishes, keep your customers happy, and bring in the MONEY!
⭐ Serve a large variety of customers, including villains, MVPs, and plenty of familiar faces!

🕷️ Welcome to +1 Spider Arm! 🕷️

HOW TO PLAY:
🦾 Ride a mechanical spider armature that walks, clings and climbs for you!
🧗 Hold SPACE to climb walls, hang under ceilings and swing across gaps.
💪 Train to level up and get +1 ARM. More arms means more speed and more grip!
✊ Watch your grip! It drains while you hang, so run out and you FALL.
🌋 Escape 13 wild stages: rooftops, sand canyons, frost arches, lava, a haunted castle, a giant snake and more!
🏆 Earn Wins at the end of each stage to unlock 1
